judgment.rationale: This is a real 0.101/dev-build Peek telemetry issue, but linked PR #49963 already handles it.
evidence: The issue reports folder selection falling through to UnsupportedFilePreviewer and logging ErrorEvent.FailureType.FileNotSupported.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
PR #49963 changes UnsupportedFilePreviewer so FileNotSupported telemetry is skipped for FolderItem.
judgment.recommended_action: Track upstream PR #49963; no separate dashboard design/action.

issue_context.summary: Peek logs FileNotSupported telemetry when a folder is selected because folders reach the unsupported previewer path.
known_information: Reporter provided exact reproduction and identified the telemetry event.
No bug report ZIP is needed for the clear code-path report.
The issue is assigned to daverayment and linked to PR #49963.
The linked PR is open and includes an UnsupportedFilePreviewer change.
inferences: The issue is likely a genuine 0.101/dev-build regression or cleanup item in Peek telemetry, not merely a version mention.
Because the linked PR directly guards FolderItem telemetry, separate design work would duplicate active upstream work.
issue_context.analysis: Current ownership and linked PR evidence are sufficient; no maintainer action should be exposed from Pulse beyond monitoring existing work.
initial_investigation: PR #49963 diff adds a check so ErrorEvent.FailureType.FileNotSupported is written only when Item is not FolderItem.
The same PR also handles #50019, indicating the two Peek reports are being addressed together.
